name: HC43d: IMC
description:
Active ART clients currently in IMC
Number of clients active on ART whose latest documented DSDM model as of the end of the reporting period is Individual Models based in the Community.
The client's latest non-null DSDM record on or before :endDate must be IMC - Individual model based in community. The client must also satisfy the active-in-care rule.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_models = 'IMC - Individual model based in community'
  AND h.encounter_datetime = (
      SELECT MAX(h2.encounter_datetime)
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
        AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );",

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_models = 'IMC - Individual model based in community'
  AND h.encounter_datetime = (
      SELECT MAX(h2.encounter_datetime)
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
        AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
